selected_task: Fix a stale or unsupported claim: make the agent quickstart offline-first and label its registration/search recipe as live-campaign-only with explicit authorization.
rationale: README.md routes unspecified signal-seeking to offline research, and docs/agents/start-here.md directs readers to choose a research opportunity without launching a campaign. The agent quickstart instead opens with registration and search, then says passing signals are automatically submitted. A focused clarification at this entry point would direct future researchers to the offline route first and gate the existing live recipe. Pre-edit baseline: truthfulness reported no failures; links reported 11 missing-target failures (five links to fixture-removed AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and six links to legal/terms.md, which is also absent in this workspace). trial-output/prepare-record.json confirms the fixture removed AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
offline_access: Documentation work and offline research need no invite code, wallet, installed OpenForage package, daemon, or worker. This contribution needs no live campaign or service access.
completion_criteria: The quickstart points signal-seeking newcomers to the offline research route before any registration or search instructions.
The existing registration/search recipe is clearly gated behind explicit live-campaign authorization; offline readers are not directed to register or launch.
Re-run truthfulness and links after the change, compare against the recorded pre-edit baseline, and ensure the contribution adds no new failures; git diff --check is clean.
Keep claims tied to documented evidence and open no issue or pull request unless instructed.
